conviction_note: No profit warning, no pre-release and no company guidance, so the Q3 numbers are genuinely new. The bar was raised about 15% in the last 30 days (Yahoo EPS 2.0 to 2.3; ABG expects EBIT +24% q/q, about 222 MSEK) and now sits at trend, so the print-vs-bar read is only mildly positive (+2%). The reaction leans slightly negative: the stock has given back 4% since the Danske-driven +15% day, ABG called it fully valued and flagged feed-cost risk, and the last two beats were sold intraday. The owner contest (Lusiaves, Lantmännen, Qviberg) cushions the downside. Findings sum -0.5 and the scaled number is -0.27 (p_up 47 on a 4.5% move). Both are small and agree in sign.

findings.finding: Three strategic holders are contesting control and soak up the free float. Grupo Lusiaves (about 22%) bought about 171k shares on 18-24 Sep at about 169-170 and has made no purchase since. Lantmännen is at 13.39% after a 1.6m-share buy. The Qviberg sphere (about 30% of votes) says it will not sell. That leaves a strategic bid under the stock on any post-print weakness, and Lusiaves' buying may resume once the report is out.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-09-18 Danske day (+15.4%) coincided with Lusiaves buying 119,561 of about 360k shares traded. When the buying stopped after 24 Sep the stock drifted from 171 to 158-165.
findings.original_quote: Portugisiska Grupo Lusiaves har köpt aktier vid 28 tillfällen i år, Lantmännen flaggade nyligen för ett storköp om 1,6 miljoner aktier – men den tyngsta maktfaktorn är Mats Qvibergs Öresund som tillsammans med familjens privata aktier kontrollerar runt 30 procent av rösterna (Portugal's Grupo Lusiaves has bought shares on 28 occasions this year, Lantmännen recently flagged a large purchase of 1.6 million shares, but the heaviest power factor is Mats Qviberg's Öresund, which together with the family's private shares controls around 30 percent of the votes)
findings.why_not_priced: The Swedish press and the FI insider register carry it, but no English wire does. If this support were priced, the stock would have held 170 after the Danske day rather than giving back 4-7% once the Lusiaves prints stopped. Whether buying resumes on report day is not dated, so the finding is kept small.

findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is the bar itself. What may not be fully reflected is that the bar now sits at trend, so a merely in-line print no longer clears it the way Q3 2025 did. The 4% fade since 22 Sep suggests the market is partly adjusting. Kept small.

findings.finding: Feed-cost pressure is the outlook risk. ABG downgraded on 15 Oct citing short-term margin pressure from rising feed raw-material prices; Lantmännen (a feed supplier and 13% holder) has warned of a weaker-than-normal 2026 Swedish harvest and energy-driven fertiliser and gas costs; and the Q2 report itself flagged geopolitics' impact on energy and feed costs. The CEO's Q4 and 2027 comment is the line it would move.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No numeric guide is ever given; the Q2-26 outlook paragraph flagged energy and feed and the stock closed -0.85% then -2.57% the next day. A historical feed-driven profit warning (Affärsvärlden, undated) shows the line can matter.
findings.original_quote: Vi ser aktien som nära fullvärderad, och även om Scandi Standard historiskt har fört vidare prishöjningar till konsumenten ser vi en risk för kortsiktig marginalpress från ökande råvarupriser på foder (We see the share as close to fully valued, and although Scandi Standard has historically passed price increases on to the consumer, we see a risk of short-term margin pressure from rising feed raw-material prices)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: it is an analyst view and the stock was flat on the downgrade day. It is macro-to-company transmission that the company has not quantified, so it is sized small. If fully priced, the market would already discount a margin dip in the Q4 consensus, yet Yahoo's Q4 EPS estimate is still +22% y/y (1.80 vs 1.47).

findings.finding: Glenhaven deal costs probably land in Q3 as non-comparable items. The deal was signed 30 July with Davy, Rabobank, Matheson, Ro Sommernes, Gernandt & Danielsson and Deloitte as advisers, and completion is around 9 Oct; Scandi reports non-comparable items separately. Reported EPS could therefore print below the 2.30 bar while adjusted EBIT does not, a headline risk that is an inference and not a disclosed number.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No non-comparable items in Q2-26 or Q2-25 (APM table), so there is no recent precedent on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The adviser list is public but the cost is not quantified anywhere. If the market expected a reported-EPS miss from it, the consensus would carry a reported/adjusted split, and Yahoo shows a single 2.30. It is a one-off with no path to the guide, so it is sized at a fraction.

lessons_applied: 'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until the company has said it': feed-cost finding cut from -0.5 to -0.4 (the company named feed and energy in Q2 but has not quantified anything).

'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0' / partly priced: bar-raise finding cut from -0.5 to -0.4, since the bar and the ABG downgrade are both public and the stock was flat on the downgrade.
'Guidance reiterated or none: median 2.3%' against 'new numbers 7.4%': with no numeric guide ever given, abs_move held at 4.5 rather than raised to 7. p_up and abs_move are otherwise unchanged.
